_note: The January 2027 lineup: 8 scheduled anchor sessions plus ideas waiting for five people. Real sessions will move to D1. See docs/schema.md.

sessions.title: AI Friday: the kickoff
sessions.description: The month starts here. Coffee, a few short demos from people around town, and a look at everything on the calendar.

sessions.title: Coffee and AI
sessions.description: No agenda. Bring your laptop and whatever you’re working on or stuck on. Someone who uses AI every day will sit down next to you and help.

sessions.title: Cooking with AI
sessions.description: Plan a week of dinners from what’s in your fridge, scale a recipe for a crowd, and see a few fun kitchen projects. A good first session if you’ve never used AI.

sessions.title: Coffee and AI
sessions.description: No agenda. Bring your laptop and whatever you’re working on or stuck on. Someone who uses AI every day will sit down next to you and help.

sessions.title: AI for real estate agents
sessions.description: Turn photos and notes into a listing, write follow-ups that sound like you, and keep track of every lead. Bring a real listing to work on.

sessions.title: AI Friday: show and tell
sessions.description: What New Orleans made this month. Short demos from people who came to their first session two weeks ago.

sessions.title: AI for churches and ministries
sessions.description: For clergy and church staff: bulletins, newsletters, volunteer schedules, and sermon research. What AI is good for, what it isn’t, and where to be careful.

sessions.title: Last call: beer and AI
sessions.description: One more evening before the parades. Work on your project, show what you made this month, and trade notes over a beer.

sessions.title: Your first hour with AI
sessions.description: Never really tried it? We’ll set up a free account together and do three useful things with it. No question is too basic.

sessions.title: AI for parents: school, sports, and carpools
sessions.description: Get every school email, practice schedule, and permission slip into one plan for the week. Then let AI help with the reminders.

sessions.title: AI for small business owners
sessions.description: Quotes, invoices, emails, and the reviews you haven’t answered yet. Bring the task you keep putting off and leave with it done.

sessions.title: Is it real? Spotting AI fakes and scams
sessions.description: Fake voices, fake photos, and fake emails are getting better. Learn what to look for, and how to help your parents spot them too.

sessions.title: AI for teachers
sessions.description: Build a week of lesson plans, quizzes, and parent emails from one standard, and talk through what to allow in your classroom.

sessions.title: AI for restaurants and bars
sessions.description: Write menu descriptions, answer reviews, and draft a staff schedule in about an hour.

sessions.title: AI for nonprofits: grants and reports
sessions.description: Draft a grant narrative from your old applications and a few notes, then check it for gaps. Bring a real deadline.

sessions.title: AI for lawyers
sessions.description: Summarize a long file, draft a first pass, and learn where AI makes things up so you know what to check.

sessions.title: Make your first app without coding
sessions.description: Describe a small tool you wish you had, and build it with AI in one sitting. You leave with a link you can share.

sessions.title: Past the chat box: let AI do the work
sessions.description: Most people ask AI a question and then do the work themselves. See how to hand it the whole task: files, research, and follow-through.

sessions.title: Get AI to write like you
sessions.description: Teach it your voice with a few of your own emails and posts, so the drafts sound like you and not like a robot.

sessions.title: Turn a messy spreadsheet into answers
sessions.description: Bring the spreadsheet nobody wants to open. Clean it up, ask it questions, and make a chart you can share.

sessions.title: Build an agent that answers your email
sessions.description: Set up an assistant that drafts replies to your inbox and asks before it sends.

sessions.title: Build-along: a what’s-for-dinner app
sessions.description: We build one small app together in 90 minutes, start to finish, out loud. Bring a laptop and follow along or just watch.

sessions.title: Fix the city: a civic build day
sessions.description: Pick a real New Orleans problem, like a city form, a data set, or a service that’s hard to use, and build something small that helps.
